title: Confine all agent file, shell, and deployment tools via PreToolUse gates
decision: PreToolUse sandbox_gate denies path traversal (../), secret files (.env, *.pem, *.key), destructive shell commands (rm -rf, git push --force), and unapproved infra mutations (terraform apply -auto-approve).
pitfall: Unbounded tools allow accidental secret exfiltration or destructive production mutations.

title: Enforce strict typing, domain exceptions, and clean layer boundaries in Python/FastAPI services
decision: Domain and service modules must use explicit type annotations, Decimal for exact monetary math, custom domain exceptions instead of generic ValueError/RuntimeError, and dependency injection for repositories.
pitfall: Unguided LLMs routinely mix float arithmetic with Decimal, raise generic ValueError, or bypass service/repository boundaries.

title: Standardize Angular modules on Standalone Components, Signals, and strict TypeScript
decision: All new Angular UI features must use standalone components, Signals for reactive state, strict TypeScript (no implicit/explicit any), and deterministic unit specs.
pitfall: LLMs often fall back to legacy NgModule boilerplate or untyped `any` casts when rules are not injected.

title: Require pinned providers, zero hardcoded secrets, and plan-before-apply in Terraform
decision: All Terraform configurations must pin provider versions, pass `terraform fmt -check` and `terraform validate`, never hardcode credentials, and never execute `-auto-approve` inside autonomous agent loops.
pitfall: Autonomous agents may attempt `terraform apply -auto-approve` or omit version constraints without a PreToolUse deployment gate.

title: Gate agent termination with Stop-hook verification and checkpoint rollback
decision: Every autonomous edit cycle must pass stack-aware verification at the Stop gate, emit JSONL telemetry metrics, and maintain pre-edit checkpoints for safe state recovery.
pitfall: Without a Stop gate, agents frequently declare victory after writing code that fails lint or unit tests.
